grades.quote: The CSRRS[I] an CSRRC[I] instructions only action side effects for fields for which the _rs1_ or _uimm_ argument has at least one bit set corresponding to that field.
grades.reason: This RISC-V Zicsr passage covers CSRRS/CSRRC behavior. Table 7 says they always read the CSR and write only when rs1 is not x0. It also says side effects apply only to fields whose bits are set in the rs1/uimm mask. It doesn't state outright that CSRRS sets and CSRRC clears the masked bits, so it is only a partial answer.
